fold_rule: Match-excluded fitting; one deterministic inner development match inside fitting set selects epoch; refit all fitting matches. No predicted match in fitting/stopping.
reused_development_context: Architecture/lr fixed from earlier 132877 selection; all new fold stopping stays inside upstream fitting matches. Not fresh nested architecture selection.
receiver_selection: Same width/lr grid and MRR early stopping for every variant, six OOF fitting matches and development 132877.
fallback: Use same-seed separately trained A logits on rows without forecast coverage. Never drop full-set frozen examples.
asof_rule: Separate sensitivity, floor(BAS_ms/40), regenerate all base/forecast inputs and anonymous candidate order at as-of frame; no physical contact synchronization claim.
